queries: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(rental_total) AS average_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.rental_total) AS combined_payment_total, AVG(rt.rental_total - sa.average_total) AS average_amount_above_average FROM rental_totals rt JOIN store_averages sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.rental_total > sa.average_total GROUP BY rt.store_id;

WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(rental_total) AS average_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.rental_total) AS combined_payment_total, AVG(rt.rental_total - oa.average_total) AS average_amount_above_average FROM rental_totals rt CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE rt.rental_total > oa.average_total GROUP BY rt.store_id;

WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id), compared AS (SELECT store_id, payment_total, AVG(payment_total) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS average_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT store_id, SUM(payment_total) AS combined_payment_total, AVG(payment_total - average_total) AS average_amount_above_average FROM compared WHERE payment_total > average_total GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
